Main title 'Deep  Learning' centered horizontally in the upper-middle (~25-35% height); 'DSAI 308' centered directly beneath it. A centered credit block ('Prepared By' / presenter name / email) sits at ~55-68% height. Bottom-left holds an 'Instructors:' block with two names and emails stacked. Bottom-right holds the Zewail City logo. A small yellow oval slide-number badge ('1') sits in the top-right corner inside the frame. A tiny gray '+' crosshair mark floats at left-center (~17% from left, ~37% from top).

No bullet characters anywhere; all bottom-left lines are left-aligned, center block is center-aligned.

Draw a rectangle covering the slide inset ~3% from each edge: no fill, solid dark-red (#C00000) outline ~2-3pt; leave the default white slide margin visible outside it. 3. Add a centered text box at ~22-45% height with two paragraphs: 'Deep  Learning' (keep the double space) and 'DSAI 308' — Arial bold ~54pt, color #C00000, center-aligned. 4. Add a second centered text box at ~55-68% height with three paragraphs: 'Prepared By' (Arial bold italic ~24pt, #C00000), 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' (Arial bold ~24pt, #1414B8), 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial bold ~16pt, #1414B8); center-aligned. 5. Add a left-aligned text box at bottom-left (~5% from left, ~75% from top) with five paragraphs: 'Instructors:' (Arial bold italic ~20pt, #C00000), 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' (Arial bold ~20pt, #1414B8), 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial ~14pt, #1414B8), 'Dr. Mohamed Maher Ata' (Arial bold ~20pt, #1414B8), 'momaher@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial bold italic ~14pt, #1414B8). 6. Insert the Zewail City logo (teal pyramids emblem + white panel with Arabic line and 'University of Science and Technology') at the bottom-right corner, roughly 30% slide width. 7. Draw a small oval in the top-right corner (~4% wide): fill #FFFF99, outline #7030A0 ~1pt, with black text '1' (~14pt) centered. 8. Optionally add a small light-gray '+' text character at ~17% left / ~37% top to match the stray artifact. 9. No animations or transitions.
